afterSql:

beforeSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(
         100.0 * (order_cnt - LAG(order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month))
         / NULLIF(LAG(order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0),
         2
       ) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000;
afterSql:
-- 每月订单量及环比增长率
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       order_cnt,
       ROUND(
           (order_cnt - LAG(order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric
           / NULLIF(LAG(order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0),
           4
       ) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS never_changed_product_count
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM product_price_history h
    WHERE h.product_id = p.product_id
      AND h.old_price IS DISTINCT FROM h.new_price
);
afterSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_cnt
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM product_price_history h
    WHERE h.product_id = p.product_id
);

beforeSql:
SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_status
ORDER BY o.order_status
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.price), 0), 2) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_status
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
SELECT m.level_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_consumption
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY m.level_id
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 20;

afterSql:
SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refund_count
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY refund_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 4) AS refund_order_ratio FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 201

beforeSql: SELECT ml.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count FROM member_levels ml LEFT JOIN members m ON m.level_id = ml.level_id LEFT JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.member_id = m.member_id AND utm.tag_id = (SELECT tag_id FROM user_tags WHERE tag_code = 'CHURN_RISK') GROUP BY ml.level_id ORDER BY ml.level_id LIMIT 201
afterSql:
SELECT m.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.member_id = m.member_id
JOIN user_tags ut ON ut.tag_id = utm.tag_id
WHERE ut.tag_code = 'CHURN_RISK'
GROUP BY m.level_id
ORDER BY m.level_id
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
SELECT r.region_name,
       COUNT(*) AS shipment_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS covered_order_count
FROM shipments s
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, r.region_name
LIMIT 100;

SELECT st.category_id,
       st.priority,
       COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count,
       COUNT(tm.message_id) AS message_count
FROM support_tickets st
LEFT JOIN ticket_messages tm ON tm.ticket_id = st.ticket_id
GROUP BY st.category_id, st.priority
ORDER BY st.category_id, st.priority
LIMIT 200;
afterSql:
SELECT tc.category_name, st.priority, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count, COUNT(tm.message_id) AS message_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
LEFT JOIN ticket_messages tm ON tm.ticket_id = st.ticket_id
GROUP BY tc.category_id, tc.category_name, st.priority
ORDER BY tc.category_name, st.priority
LIMIT 100;
